courses.title: Approaches to Health
courses.description: Explores how health and wellbeing are influenced by cultural, ethical, and historical factors, encouraging students to examine health beyond the biological model. Through critical analysis and engagement with social sciences and humanities disciplines, students will develop a nuanced understanding of how art, literature, philosophy, and cultural narratives shape our experiences of health and illness. No prior knowledge required; suitable for students across all disciplines.
